name: Brennan & Marsh
blurb: A small law firm's document server. Its firewall is run for it by an outside company.
banner: Perimeter protection by Gatehouse Managed Security.

content.text:
DRAFT · NOT SENT

Dear Ms. Adeyemi-Clarke,

We act for Corvane Mutual. Our client has noted your recent remarks to the press. Bundle 7, which we will serve on Friday, contains material our client believes you will not want made public.

We suggest you reconsider.

S. Brennan

DISCLOSURE PROTOCOL. Internal.

A disclosure bundle is the set of documents we hand to the other side. It is assembled by an associate, checked by a senior associate and released by a partner. It is not to be assembled by a client, a client’s friend, or anyone who says they are in a hurry.

Bundle 7 was assembled in a hurry.

TICKET: our firewall is managed by Gatehouse. When it breaks, we call Gatehouse. When Gatehouse breaks, we do not have a procedure.

Proposed procedure: do not break Gatehouse. Status: approved.
